verses.text: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for He is good, For His lovingkindness is everlasting.
verses.textZh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！

verses.text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say [so], Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the adversary
verses.textZh: 願耶和華的贖民說這話，就是他從敵人手中所救贖的，

verses.text: And gathered from the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
verses.textZh: 從各地，從東從西，從南從北，所招聚來的。

verses.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert region; They did not find a way to an inhabited city.
verses.textZh: 他們在曠野荒地漂流，尋不見可住的城邑，

verses.text: [They were] hungry and thirsty; Their soul fainted within them.
verses.textZh: 又飢又渴，心裡發昏。

verses.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble; He delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.textZh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中搭救他們，

verses.text: He led them also by a straight way, To go to an inhabited city.
verses.textZh: 又領他們行走直路，使他們往可居住的城邑。

verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His lovingkindness, And for His wonders to the sons of men!
verses.textZh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；

verses.text: For He has satisfied the thirsty soul, And the hungry soul He has filled with what is good.
verses.textZh: 因他使心裡渴慕的人得以知足，使心裡飢餓的人得飽美物。

verses.text: There were those who dwelt in darkness and in the shadow of death, Prisoners in misery and chains,
verses.textZh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死蔭裡的人被困苦和鐵鍊捆鎖，

verses.text: Because they had rebelled against the words of God And spurned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.textZh: 是因他們違背神的話語，藐視至高者的旨意。

verses.text: Therefore He humbled their heart with labor; They stumbled and there was none to help.
verses.textZh: 所以，他用勞苦治服他們的心；他們仆倒，無人扶助。

verses.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble; He saved them out of their distresses.
verses.textZh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。

verses.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death And broke their bands apart.
verses.textZh: 他從黑暗中和死蔭裡領他們出來，折斷他們的綁索。

verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His lovingkindness, And for His wonders to the sons of men!
verses.textZh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；

verses.text: For He has shattered gates of bronze And cut bars of iron asunder.
verses.textZh: 因為他打破了銅門，砍斷了鐵閂。

verses.text: Fools, because of their rebellious way, And because of their iniquities, were afflicted.
verses.textZh: 愚妄人因自己的過犯和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。

verses.text: Their soul abhorred all kinds of food, And they drew near to the gates of death.
verses.textZh: 他們心裡厭惡各樣的食物，就臨近死門。

verses.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble; He saved them out of their distresses.
verses.textZh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。

verses.text: He sent His word and healed them, And delivered [them] from their destructions.
verses.textZh: 他發命醫治他們，救他們脫離死亡。

verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His lovingkindness, And for His wonders to the sons of men!
verses.textZh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。

verses.text: Let them also offer sacrifices of thanksgiving, And tell of His works with joyful singing.
verses.textZh: 願他們以感謝為祭獻給他，歡呼述說他的作為！

verses.text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, Who do business on great waters;
verses.textZh: 在海上坐船，在大水中經理事務的，

verses.text: They have seen the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep.
verses.textZh: 他們看見耶和華的作為，並他在深水中的奇事。

verses.text: For He spoke and raised up a stormy wind, Which lifted up the waves of the sea.
verses.textZh: 因他一吩咐，狂風就起來，海中的波浪也揚起。

verses.text: They rose up to the heavens, they went down to the depths; Their soul melted away in [their] misery.
verses.textZh: 他們上到天空，下到海底；他們的心因患難便消化。

verses.text: They reeled and staggered like a drunken man, And were at their wits' end.
verses.textZh: 他們搖搖幌幌，東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；他們的智慧無法可施。

verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.
verses.textZh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華，他從他們的禍患中領出他們來。

verses.text: He caused the storm to be still, So that the waves of the sea were hushed.
verses.textZh: 他使狂風止息，波浪就平靜。

verses.text: Then they were glad because they were quiet, So He guided them to their desired haven.
verses.textZh: 風息浪靜，他們便歡喜；他就引他們到所願去的海口。

verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His lovingkindness, And for His wonders to the sons of men!
verses.textZh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。

verses.text: Let them extol Him also in the congregation of the people, And praise Him at the seat of the elders.
verses.textZh: 願他們在民的會中尊崇他，在長老的位上讚美他！

verses.text: He changes rivers into a wilderness And springs of water into a thirsty ground;
verses.textZh: 他使江河變為曠野，叫水泉變為乾渴之地，

verses.text: A fruitful land into a salt waste, Because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.textZh: 使肥地變為鹼地；這都因其間居民的罪惡。

verses.text: He changes a wilderness into a pool of water And a dry land into springs of water;
verses.textZh: 他使曠野變為水潭，叫旱地變為水泉。

verses.text: And there He makes the hungry to dwell, So that they may establish an inhabited city,
verses.textZh: 他使飢餓的人住在那裡，好建造可住的城邑，

verses.text: And sow fields and plant vineyards, And gather a fruitful harvest.
verses.textZh: 又種田地，栽葡萄園，得享所出的土產。

verses.text: Also He blesses them and they multiply greatly, And He does not let their cattle decrease.
verses.textZh: 他又賜福給他們，叫他們生養眾多，也不叫他們的牲畜減少。

verses.text: When they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, misery and sorrow,
verses.textZh: 他們又因暴虐、患難、愁苦，就減少且卑下。

verses.text: He pours contempt upon princes And makes them wander in a pathless waste.
verses.textZh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流。

verses.text: But He sets the needy securely on high away from affliction, And makes [his] families like a flock.
verses.textZh: 他卻將窮乏人安置在高處，脫離苦難，使他的家屬多如羊群。

verses.text: The upright see it and are glad; But all unrighteousness shuts its mouth.
verses.textZh: 正直人看見就歡喜；罪孽之輩必塞口無言。

verses.text: Who is wise? Let him give heed to these things, And consider the lovingkindnesses of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 凡有智慧的，必在這些事上留心，也必思想耶和華的慈愛。
